uploadKeys.description: 1 to 5 uploadKeys from prepare_upload, one per image, after each PUT has succeeded

download_url.description: the attachment's download URL, supplied by the client

file_id.description: the client's id for the attachment

mime_type.description: the attachment's media type, when the client knows it

file_name.description: the attachment's original filename, when the client knows it

imageFiles.description: 1 to 5 photographs the user attached to the conversation, all of the SAME person

prompt.description: describe the ONE character to generate, 1-1000 characters

refine.description: run the refine pass for higher fidelity (default true). Send false ONLY when the user asks for a faster or cheaper character

visibility.description: private (default), unlisted, or public in the user's PINOC library

assetPublicId.description: the asset's UUID, from take_library_motion, wait_for_tasks or list_motion_library. NOT a task id

format.description: optional: one format to get a URL for. Required for a format listed as onDemand (a motion's splat-skeleton files), which has no URL until it is built: naming it starts the build and returns the URL, or an exportId to wait on with wait_for_tasks. A scene has one file and no format to choose, so leave this out for one

assetPublicIds.description: the asset UUIDs to look up, from take_library_motion(s), wait_for_tasks or list_motion_library. NOT task ids. Repeats are collapsed

filename.description: the file's name with extension, e.g. dance.mp4

sizeBytes.description: exact file size in bytes, from stat or ls -l

kind.description: motion, video_motion, character or environment - whichever tool started it - or export for an exportId from get_asset or download_asset

taskId.description: the taskId returned by the generating tool, or the exportId

tasks.description: the tasks to poll, up to 20. Poll them together rather than one at a time

timeoutSeconds.description: how long to wait before reporting back, 0 to 90 (default 45). 0 checks once and returns
